chunks: So We inspired to him: 'Construct the ark under Our eyes and Our guidance.' When Our command comes and the spring boils over, put into it a pair of each species, and your family except those upon whom the word has already been passed, and do not speak to Me for those who are wicked; indeed, they will be drowned.

key_terms.سَبَقَ الْقَوْلُ: The word/command had been passed (destiny decreed)

ai.seo_question: What were the specific instructions Allah gave to Prophet Noah regarding the construction of the Ark and who would be saved?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the phrase 'bi-a'yunina' (with Our eyes) emphasizes Allah's direct, continuous observation of Noah during the Ark's construction, highlighting the divine guarantee of the vessel's integrity. The exclusion of specific family members underscores the principle that salvation is contingent upon individual faith rather than mere lineage, a key theme in Shia theology. This verse also marks the transition from the preparatory phase of the flood to its imminent execution, signaled by the 'fara al-tnnour' (boiling of the oven), a miraculous sign of the earth's waters erupting.
